findings.description: In the foreground, the man's right hand holds the tool tucked low against his jawline and chin, whereas in the mirror reflection the tool is positioned high up directly over his upper lip and mustache.

The implement in the man's hand morphs from a toothbrush-like stick at his mouth into a tiny comb/razor that he runs across his eyebrow and scalp hair (00:02-00:04), and then holds hovering against his cheek (00:06-00:09), all while continuous tooth-brushing sound effects play.
